title: Ghadeer e Khum ka Suraj
body:
Ghadeer e khum ka suraj kaam kya purkaar karta hai
kisi ko noor karta hai kisi ko naar karta hai
Wilayat se ali ki aaj jo inkaar karta hai
wo apne badnasab hone ka khud iqraar karta hai
Nishaa'n deewaar ka ye aaj bhi iqraar karta hai
kaaba toot kar maula ali se pyaar karta hai
Hasee meesam ke hotho'n par dame aakhir hai kyu maula
mujhe lagta hai jaise aapka deedar karta hai
Yehi pehchaan hai logo zamane mein muqassir ki
zabaa'n iqraar karti hai, amal inkaar karta hai
Nuseri se bada mushrik nahi dekha koi maine
jo apne hi khuda ki baat ka inkaar karta hai
Nishaa'n deewaar ka ye aaj bhi iqraar karta hai
ke kaaba toot kar maula ali se pyaar karta hai
